_why: TWENTY-TWO CATALOGUE RECORDS THAT CAN NEVER MATERIALIZE, RETIRED ONTO THEIR SURVIVORS (#1319).

site_b holds 13 same-owner identical-produced-byte groups over 35 `local` records. App identity is (owner_user_ref, file_hash) (app/schema.sql:5298) and no DedupBehavior value relaxes it, so each group can hold exactly one row. SeedInsertAsset ends in a bare ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (app/internal/seed/queries.sql:281-286), the ErrNoRows branch finds no row under the loser's own id and counts a `deduped` (app/internal/seed/runner.go:830-863), so 22 records get no id, no declaration, no size and no field values, and 25 posts silently ship 37 members short.

EVIDENCE KIND IS `preserved_archive`, THE WEAKER CLAIM, AND IS NEVER DESCRIBED AS ANYTHING ELSE. These are `local` records: 0 of the 35 carry metadata.media_url, 0 carry metadata.source_archive and 0 carry metadata.sha256, and the old $DATASET_SRC is permanently retired. There is no source to re-derive from, so no member, no render size, no rasteriser and no produced-hash claim is made, and no `pool_of_record` is recorded. retired_sha256 and survivor_sha256 are EQUAL by design: that equality IS the documented byte collapse, and it is the opposite of the produced-source rule, where the two hashes describe different bytes and must DIFFER.

Authority is a FROZEN PRE-OPERATION SNAPSHOT attested by an external manifest and recomputed immediately before use, never the archive agreeing with itself, because a stale copy agrees with itself perfectly (ADR 0097, amendment 2026-09-24).

SURVIVORS ARE CHOSEN BY A DETERMINISTIC RULE, NOT BY WHICHEVER HAPPENED TO MATERIALIZE: the member earliest in profile (JSON) order, which is the row applyAssets reaches first (app/internal/seed/runner.go:762), qualified by the readable-bytes rule (:763-768). All 35 files are present in the archive, so the qualifier excludes nothing here and is recorded because it is part of the rule rather than because it bit.

Losses are ENUMERATED, never inferred. Both layers recompute the list from retired_record against the survivor and refuse on any disagreement, so the data cannot move under the document. 207 losses over the 22 entries: 32 retired-only and 175 differing, over 19 distinct paths.

Post membership: 25 posts, 132 members to 108, none emptied. 13 asset_group posts keep their id because it derives from the source group_id; the 7 project_sprint and 5 team_roundup ids derive from MEMBERSHIP and move, each composed onto the existing chain in post-id-migration.studio-b.json. site_b has no post-curation document, so no pipeline_members digest moves.
